faq.q: What’s the difference between Digital and Visual?
faq.a: Digital is what we build and run online: websites, apps, analytics and marketing. Visual is what your customers see: photography, videography, social media management and live streaming. Most clients use both, and packages like Website + Content Capture already include a shoot.

faq.q: Which service should I start with?
faq.a: Start where you lose the most customers. If people can’t find you, start with Marketing and the GBP Content Refresh. If they find you but don’t reach out, start with Web Design & Development. If your photos and feed feel stale, start with Photography, Videography or a monthly content plan. Not sure? The free Growth Audit will tell you.

faq.q: How much does it cost to get started?
faq.a: Digital: Google Business Profile work starts at $400, tracking setup at $500 and a Webflow or Shopify website at $800. Visual: social profile setup starts at $350, product photography at $400, a brand photo session at $450, a short-form video pack at $600 and live streaming at $900 per event.

faq.q: What monthly plans do you offer?
faq.a: Every service has a monthly option. Digital: Website Care from $150/mo, Monthly Insights from $250/mo, App Care from $400/mo, Ads Management from $500/mo and Full Growth Partner from $1,200/mo. Visual: Monthly Photo Plan from $400/mo, Content + Growth Retainer from $450/mo, Monthly Video Plan and Managed Social from $500/mo each, and Recurring Streams from $1,800/mo. All are month-to-month under the agreed scope.

faq.q: Which offers can I book online?
faq.a: Six packages have online checkout: GBP Content Refresh, Website Only, Website + Content Capture, Website + Extended Content, Content + Growth Retainer and Full Growth Partner. Every other offer starts with a quick quote so we can confirm scope, dates and total first.

faq.q: What do I get at handoff?
faq.a: You own what we make. Websites are built in, or moved to, your own Webflow or Shopify account. Apps ship with the code in a GitHub repository you own and hosting in your name. Photos and videos come licensed for your business marketing. Every project ends with a training call or recorded walkthrough and a support window for fixes; each offer lists its exact handoff.

faq.q: Do you maintain websites and apps after launch?
faq.a: Yes. Website Care starts at $150/mo and App Care & Support at $400/mo. Both include monitoring, updates and a set number of edit or development hours each month. Sites and apps we didn't build start with a one-time review.

faq.q: How do bigger shoots and more products change the price?
faq.a: More products, photos, videos or live hours take more time on site, so each offer shows its size table. For example, product photography is $400 for up to 10 products, $850 for up to 25 and $1,600 for up to 50.

It is the minimum published price for the deliverables listed on that offer. The final quote depends on your pages, features, shoot time, locations and deliverables; we confirm the scope and total with you before starting.

faq.q: Can you quote a $1,200 small-business website or a $2,500 website and shoot?
faq.a: Yes. Those are examples of expanded project scopes above the minimum. We discuss your goals and existing assets, then quote only the work you need.

faq.q: Do I need a new website to work with SWFT?
faq.a: No. Start with any single service, like a photo session, a Google Business Profile refresh or a monthly content plan, if your existing site is already doing its job.

faq.q: Are ads and third-party subscriptions included?
faq.a: Ad spend, Webflow or Shopify subscriptions, domains, hosting, CRM and messaging fees and other third-party costs are separate unless specifically included in your written proposal.
No. One-time projects are scoped per engagement. Monthly plans are month-to-month under the agreed scope.

faq.q: How long does a project take?
faq.a: Timing depends on the assets you supply, page count, features, shoot schedule, feedback and approval turnaround. We confirm a realistic timeline during intake.
